item.title: Open-Source Personal AI Agent Statistics (November 2026)
item.description:
Of 9 open-source personal AI agents we checked, OpenClaw has the most GitHub stars: 395,114 on 2026-11-23. Hermes Agent is second with 265,661. OpenClaw also has the most npm downloads of the packages we checked, at 12,584,254 in the last month. Stars show interest, not how well an agent works. Downloads count installs, not active users.

These numbers were pulled by aiagentmemory.org on 2026-11-23 from the GitHub, PyPI and npm APIs. The table is the script’s output, pasted without edits. The exact calls are in the Methodology section. Memory details for the two biggest agents are on the OpenClaw guide and the Hermes Agent install guide.
